summary: Regression test of the 'share-to-social' bug fix: (1) OG/Twitter meta tag rendering in served index.html and (2) ShareButtons component behaviour on /events/evt-festival-2026 and on the OrgDashboard ParsedCards. All 6 platforms (Facebook, LinkedIn, X/Twitter, WhatsApp, Instagram-copy, Copy-link) verified to open the correct destination URLs and to no longer use the deprecated `noopener,noreferrer,width,height` features string on window.open — captured `feat` was null (i.e. simple `_blank`, matching the fix). Facebook URL now uses only `?u=<encoded>` with NO deprecated `quote=` parameter. LinkedIn URL uses `share-offsite/?url=<encoded>`. Twitter and WhatsApp URLs correctly encode both text and url. Copy-link and Copy-for-Instagram populate the clipboard with the expected content and fire a Sonner toast ('Caption copied — open Instagram and paste into your post or story.'). Old Facebook connect testids (`fb-card`, `fb-connect`, `fb-disconnect`, `fb-page-name`, `parsed-post-fb`) are fully removed from both pages. On the OrgDashboard, after parsing the example flyer, 3 parsed cards each render a ShareButtons row with all 6 platforms — 18 buttons total — and clicking Facebook/LinkedIn opens the correct sharer URLs. Served HTML (curl against the preview URL after `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`) contains og:type=website, og:site_name=Blackrod Now, og:title, og:description, og:url=https://blackrodnow.com/, og:image=https://rodlife-events.preview.emergentagent.com/logo.png (ABSOLUTE https), og:image:width=512, og:image:height=512, twitter:card=summary_large_image, twitter:title, twitter:description, twitter:image=https://rodlife-events.preview.emergentagent.com/logo.png (ABSOLUTE https). NOTE: A `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` was required — before the restart, curl returned a stale HTML where og:image was `/logo.png` and og:url was missing (CRA dev-server had cached the old index.html template). Main agent should ensure the deployed build reflects the current source.
action_items: EventDetail.jsx still contains a legacy `openPopup(url)` helper (line 165) that opens Facebook / WhatsApp with the deprecated `"noopener,noreferrer,width=720,height=640"` features string. It powers the two ActionButton tiles 'Share to Facebook' and 'Share on WhatsApp' in the 'Promote this event' section below the new one-tap-share row. These will exhibit the exact same silent popup-blocked failure the user complained about. Either delete the two tiles (they are duplicated by the new ShareButtons row) or route them through the same fixed `open()` helper used in /components/ShareButtons.jsx.

index.html changes are not picked up by CRA hot reload; a supervisor restart of the frontend was needed for the new OG tags to be served. Not a code bug, but the deployed build must be rebuilt after any /public/index.html change so Facebook/LinkedIn crawlers see the absolute og:image.
critical_code_review_comments: EventDetail.jsx duplicates share functionality: the new ShareButtons row and the legacy ActionButton tiles (`Copy Facebook Post`, `Share to Facebook`, `Share on WhatsApp`, `Copy Event Link`) both try to share to the same platforms. The legacy tiles still use `openPopup` with the deprecated `noopener,noreferrer,width=720,height=640` features string (line 165–167) — this is exactly the bug that was supposed to be fixed. Consolidate onto ShareButtons or upgrade `openPopup` to use the new safe open() pattern.

ShareButtons.jsx handlers.native uses navigator.share but on desktop this will always fall back to clipboard — fine, but the fallback silently swallows errors from writeText (line 108–111). Consider logging or surfacing them as toasts for consistency with the other clipboard-based handlers.

index.html has hard-coded https://blackrodnow.com/ as og:url and https://rodlife-events.preview.emergentagent.com/logo.png as og:image — these will diverge between preview and production. Consider generating them at build time from a single env var (REACT_APP_SITE_URL) via %PUBLIC_URL% or an env replacement, so preview and prod both share the correct absolute URLs without manual edits.

OG tags in /public/index.html are static site-level and do not describe individual events. When Facebook/LinkedIn crawls /events/evt-festival-2026 they still see the generic site title/description/image. If per-event previews are required, add server-side rendering or a small backend HTML endpoint that injects per-event og:title/og:description/og:image (this is the classic SPA-share-preview limitation).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 6 platforms across both pages open correct URL, no deprecated features string, no deprecated quote param, OG/Twitter tags served with absolute URLs after frontend restart)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug is fully fixed inside /components/ShareButtons.jsx and /public/index.html. Only remaining gap is the legacy `openPopup` helper still in /pages/EventDetail.jsx (lines 165–167 + calls at shareToFacebook / shareToWhatsApp) — this powers the redundant ActionButton tiles below the new one-tap-share row and still uses the deprecated `noopener,noreferrer,width,height` features string. Not blocking the primary fix but should be cleaned up. Also: any future edits to /public/index.html require a `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` for the change to be served by CRA dev-server.
rca of the issue: Root cause: (1) window.open with `noopener,noreferrer` in the features string is silently blocked by Chromium (feature-string presence triggers popup-blocker heuristics + the noreferrer flag), so social share popups never opened for many users → 'refuse to connect'. Fix: switch to a bare `_blank` target and null the returned window.opener manually. (2) Facebook sharer.php has deprecated the `quote=` parameter since 2017 and rejects domains not verified in Business Manager with 'must use a domain you own'. Fix: send only `u=<encoded>` and rely on OG tags. (3) Facebook & LinkedIn crawlers refused to render a preview because the SPA index.html shipped no og:image / og:title. Fix: add absolute OG + Twitter Card meta tags to /public/index.html. Reproduction (pre-fix): click Facebook/LinkedIn share button → popup silently fails to open OR opens FB sharer with 'This link isn't allowed'. Post-fix: all four external platforms open their share destinations in a new tab; clipboard-based Instagram + Copy-link fire a success toast.
